integrity: Proved by support-function duality and metric projection; finite rational tests supplement, not replace, the proof. Historical priority has not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Exact for isotropic quadratic fidelity, positive ridge, finite nonzero nonnegative convex one-homogeneous penalties, and exact weighted proximal optimization. Not applicable to nonconvex penalties, correlated design matrices, transient losses or stochastic updates.
title: A sharp universal objective-inflation law for weighted proximal optimization with convex gauges
